description: Prepare settlement statements; receive closing funds; verify and release disbursement wires from the title escrow trust account
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 2.5 closings a day; a missed closing date can breach the contract and cost buyers rate locks; disbursement ledger must match wires to the minute; trust fund duties (Fla. Stat. 626.8473)
manual_workaround: Reschedule closings; manual settlement statement from the last export; release wires from the bank app with dual approval and callback
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-07; SYS-08; SYS-11
dependent_third_parties: Closing software vendor; escrow bank; title underwriter; lenders
dependent_people_or_facilities: Closing Services staff; Main Office closing rooms

description: Email, phone, chat, and the Closing Communications Portal, including delivery of wire instructions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients cannot reach the team or receive verified wire instructions; an outage invites fraudsters to fill the gap with spoofed messages
manual_workaround: Phone tree to cell phones; tell clients by phone that no wire instructions will be sent until the portal is back
dependent_systems: SYS-04; SYS-05 portal; SYS-03; phone system
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite provider; cloud provider; phone carrier

description: Contracts, addenda, deadlines, compliance review, e-signatures, deposit verification requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deadlines (inspection, financing, deposit verification within 10 business days under r. 61J2-14.008(2)(b)) run in calendar and business days
manual_workaround: Work from the weekly export of active files (once built); paper addenda signed in person

description: Receive and log earnest money and property management funds; deposit within 3 business days; monthly reconciliation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deposits must be placed within 3 business days (r. 61J2-14.008(3)); reconciliations are monthly (r. 61J2-14.012(2))
manual_workaround: Paper deposit log; deposit at the bank branch; reconcile from bank statements

description: Rent collection, owner distributions, maintenance requests, tenant and owner portals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rent is due on the 1st; owner distributions on the 10th; urgent maintenance (no water, no air conditioning in summer) must be dispatched the same day
manual_workaround: Phone line for urgent maintenance; accept paper checks; delay owner statements
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor and its payment processor

description: Listing input, website, CRM lead routing, inside sales follow-up
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Leads decay quickly, but lost leads are recoverable; listings stay live on the multiple listing service
manual_workaround: Route new leads by phone and email; post listings directly to the multiple listing service

description: Rental applications, screening reports, lease signing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Applicants wait; vacancies cost owners about 1 day of rent per day of delay
manual_workaround: Hold applications in order received; no manual scoring (FCRA and fair housing risk)
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor; screening provider

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agents are paid at closing funding; payroll is biweekly
manual_workaround: Manual commission checks; repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider

business_process: Agent onboarding, offboarding, and license compliance
description: Add and remove contractor agents and their system access; license roster
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Offboarding delays leave access open (P01 R-007); license changes are tracked weekly
manual_workaround: Disable accounts directly in each system from the admin consoles
